lines.text: Dude, tell me you didn't forget your dice bag again. Over.
Relax, it's in my backpack. I'm passing the old power plant now. Over.
Leo? Hey, did the power just go out at your house? Over.
Hello?! Dude, are you there?! Something's in the woods! The lights are going crazy, I'm running toward the fence!
Leo?! Wait, I thought you were at home!
Hey! Over here! Please, help me get over the fence, it's right behind me!
Leo, run! Climb over, I'll pull you up!
I can't... my leg's stuck. You have to come through the hole in the fence. Hurry!
DUDE! DON'T MOVE! I'm still locked in my basement, I never left my house! Whatever is standing in those woods... IT'S NOT ME! RUN!
No! Don't listen to the radio, that thing MIMICS VOICES! I'm really out here! Please don't leave me!
One of them is my best friend. The other one is a trap.
